{"ok":true,"status":"PARTIAL","facts":[{"fact_id":"F-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-001","subject_type":"qa_pair","subject_id":"qa-document-01","predicate":"qa_answer","typed_value":"【标题】：个人养老金的概念与作用
【内容】：1. 个人养老金制度是对现行养老保险制度的补充。2. 个人养老金是一种个人养老储备计划，享受免税优惠。3. 个人养老金制度提供灵活性，可根据个人情况调整养老标准。4. 个人养老金制度覆盖面更广，可结合商业保险实现个人养老需求。5. 参加个人养老金制度可以提供老年人生活品质的有效保障。","unit":null,"as_of":null,"source_call_id":"CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01","evidence_refs":["E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-01"],"identity_scope":"pi"},{"fact_id":"F-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-002","subject_type":"qa_pair","subject_id":"qa-document-02","predicate":"qa_answer","typed_value":"【标题】：个人养老金的功能与意义
【内容】：1. 个人养老金制度是国家推行的一项养老保障制度，个人自愿参加，国家从税收上给予支持。2. 个人养老金是对现行社会基本养老保险制度的补充，可以解决基本的生活保障问题。3. 个人养老金制度可以根据个人实际情况选择、调整养老金标准，制定符合自己希望的养老规划，更加灵活、人性化。4. 个人养老金比社会基本养老保险的参加限制更少、覆盖面更广，通过与商业养老保险相结合，更好地解决人们的养老问题。5. 建议个人参与个人养老金制度，是国家对个人养老规划和保障的政策支持和鼓励，可以更积极、主动、有效地进行养老准备。","unit":null,"as_of":null,"source_call_id":"CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01","evidence_refs":["E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-02"],"identity_scope":"pi"},{"fact_id":"F-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-003","subject_type":"qa_pair","subject_id":"qa-document-03","predicate":"qa_answer","typed_value":"【标题】：养老保险个人账户的定义和作用。
【内容】：1. 养老保险个人账户是为每位参加基本养老保险的个人设立的账户。2. 个人账户记录个人缴纳的养老保险费、集体补助、政府补贴以及利息金额。3. 个人账户是办理退休手续、转移或死亡时领取养老金的主要依据。4. 个人账户养老金具有强制储蓄性质，不得提前支取。","unit":null,"as_of":null,"source_call_id":"CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01","evidence_refs":["E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-03"],"identity_scope":"pi"}],"evidence":[{"evidence_id":"E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-01","source_type":"qa_pair","source_id":"τÉåσ┐╡σ»╝σàÑ_documents_insurance_corpus.txt","document_id":null,"chunk_id":null,"product_version":null,"locator":"召回序号:1","bm25_score":null,"embedding_score":null,"rerank_score":null,"retrieval_round":1,"query_rewrite":null,"retrieved_at":"2026-11-02T15:21:49.377321Z"},{"evidence_id":"E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-02","source_type":"qa_pair","source_id":"τÉåσ┐╡σ»╝σàÑ_documents_insurance_corpus.txt","document_id":null,"chunk_id":null,"product_version":null,"locator":"召回序号:2","bm25_score":null,"embedding_score":null,"rerank_score":null,"retrieval_round":1,"query_rewrite":null,"retrieved_at":"2026-11-02T15:21:49.377608Z"},{"evidence_id":"E-CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01-03","source_type":"qa_pair","source_id":"τÉåσ┐╡σ»╝σàÑ_documents_insurance_corpus.txt","document_id":null,"chunk_id":null,"product_version":null,"locator":"召回序号:3","bm25_score":null,"embedding_score":null,"rerank_score":null,"retrieval_round":1,"query_rewrite":null,"retrieved_at":"2026-11-02T15:21:49.378096Z"}],"gaps":["召回内容未经评分确认匹配程度，仅供参考"],"hint":null,"source":{"system":"qa_svc","endpoint":"/qa/recall"},"request_id":"CALL-TR-MCP-93a7e7ee8edc-01","latency_ms":2220,"error":null}
